prompt: A recipe for $4$ servings uses $6$ cups of flour. How much flour is needed for $10$ servings?
hint: Each serving needs the same amount of flour. Work out the flour for one serving and build up to ten.

hints.text: Each serving needs the same amount of flour. Work out the flour for one serving and build up to ten.
One serving uses $6 \div 4 = 1.5$ cups of flour. Multiply that by $10$ servings.
$1.5 \times 10 = 15$, so $10$ servings need $15$ cups of flour.

explanation: Find the unit rate by dividing flour by servings: $6 \div 4 = 1.5$ cups per serving.
Multiply the unit rate by the number of servings wanted: $1.5 \times 10$.
Multiplying by $10$ moves the decimal point one place right, giving $15$.
Ten servings need $15$ cups of flour.
